title: ChronoWitness: exact temporal-input identities and kinetic-reader certificates
description: Exact and independently checked software for temporal-input identities, finite-state and continuous-time kinetic reader thresholds, molecular observation bounds and statistical tests. Includes mathematical certificates and data. Manuscripts are held separately. Includes secondary cellular-data prediction and local calibration transport, support failures and adverse tail outcomes. Version 0.14 adds E6 safeguards, ten additional acquisition dates in E8, nested residual-level verification and the FD8-32 finite design frontier. Direct cellular FD7 intervention is not established by these records.
